mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.dynasty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poems pm WHERE pm.poet_id = p.id) AS relatedPoems, p.description FROM poets p ORDER BY relatedPoems DESC, p.id ASC
SELECT id, name, historical_name AS historicalName, description, longitude, latitude FROM locations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.dynasty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poems pm WHERE pm.poet_id = p.id) AS relatedPoems, p.description FROM poets p ORDER BY relatedPoems DESC, p.id ASC
SELECT id, title, content, dynasty FROM allusions WHERE location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY dynasty
SELECT dynasty, SUM(poem_count) AS count FROM location_poem_stats WHERE location_id = #{locationId} GROUP BY dynasty ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT id, name, dynasty, birth_year AS birthYear, death_year AS deathYear FROM poets WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT pr.visit_order AS `order`, pr.location_id AS locationId, l.name AS locationName, pr.visit_year AS year, pr.event_description AS event, l.longitude, l.latitude FROM poet_routes pr INNER JOIN locations l ON pr.location_id = l.id WHERE pr.poet_id = #{poetId} ORDER BY pr.visit_order ASC
SELECT pm.id, pm.title, pm.description FROM poems pm INNER JOIN poem_locations pl ON pm.id = pl.poem_id WHERE pm.poet_id = #{poetId} AND pl.location_id = #{locationId} LIMIT 10
SELECT poet1_id AS source, poet2_id AS target, relationship_type AS type, strength, description FROM poet_relationships WHERE poet1_id = #{poetId} OR poet2_id = #{poetId}

SELECT te.id, te.event_year AS year, te.event_type AS type, te.event_name AS name, te.event_description AS description, l.name AS location, te.importance FROM timeline_events te LEFT JOIN locations l ON te.location_id = l.id WHERE te.poet_id = #{poetId} ORDER BY te.event_year ASC, te.importance DESC
SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, content, dynasty FROM allusions WHERE location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY dynasty

SELECT pm.id, pm.title, p.name AS poet FROM poems pm INNER JOIN poets p ON pm.poet_id = p.id WHERE pm.id IN ( SELECT poem_id FROM poem_locations WHERE location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM allusions WHERE id = #{allusionId}) ) LIMIT 5
SELECT id, name, historical_name AS historicalName, poem_count AS poemCount, poet_count AS poetCount FROM provinces ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, name, historical_name AS historicalName, description, poem_count AS poemCount, poet_count AS poetCount FROM provinces WHERE id = #{id}
